blocks.text: Condo buildings in Forest Hills
Streets, schools and getting around Forest Hills

items.t: Forest Hills is the residential pocket on the lower south-west slopes of Burnaby Mountain in the City of Burnaby, built around Forest Grove Drive and Beaverbrook Crescent, below Simon Fraser University (SFU). "Forest Hills" is the GVR board sub-area name in the SnapStats GVR report (listing copy shortens it to "Forest Hills BN" for Burnaby North); the City-facing name for the pocket is "Forest Grove," after Forest Grove Drive, Forest Grove Elementary and Forest Grove Park. The City publishes no street-by-street written boundary for the MLS® sub-area — exact boundary streets: UNVERIFIED.

Edges and neighbours: Simon Fraser University and Simon Fraser Hills to the east and up the mountain, Oakdale and Sullivan Heights to the south-east, the Lochdale / Parkcrest side to the west, and Lougheed Town Centre to the south. Forest Grove Drive and Beaverbrook Crescent run through the pocket; Gaglardi Way is the road up Burnaby Mountain to SFU, and Lougheed Highway runs along the south side.

Where the condo stock concentrates: the attached stock is townhome complexes on Forest Grove Drive and Ash Grove Crescent — not apartment towers. No SkyTrain station sits inside Forest Hills; Production Way–University Station (Millennium Line) is south-west and is the transfer point for SFU bus service.

Boundary caution: UniverCity / SFU product belongs to the Simon Fraser Univer. One Beaverbrook Crescent complex (Avonlea) is filed by listing sources under Simon Fraser Hills and is treated accordingly.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Forest Hills

items.t: Co-op housing is not strata: the three Forest Grove / Ash Grove co-operatives in are membership housing under BC Housing's directory, not Strata Property Act purchases — no Form B, no depreciation-report regime, and no market resale applies to them.

Creek and slope: Stoney Creek runs through the area toward Burnaby Lake and the homes sit on sloped lots below the Burnaby Mountain Conservation Area — parcel-level setbacks, slope conditions and hazard status are property-specific checks: UNVERIFIED for individual lots.

blocks.text: Good to know about Forest Hills

items.t: Three of the pocket's biggest "complexes" are co-ops, not condos. Hillside Place (8400 Forest Grove Dr), Whattlekainum (8740 Forest Grove Dr) and Pine Ridge (8763 Ash Grove Cres) are all housing co-operatives in BC Housing's Zone 5 directory — they surface in address searches as large multi-unit sites, but none of them can be bought as strata.

The gondola would fly over this neighbourhood. TransLink states the proposed Burnaby Mountain Gondola would serve the 25,000 daily trips made by SFU students, staff, faculty, visitors and UniverCity residents, and its endorsed straight route passes above the Forest Grove neighbourhood — a disclosure item for Forest Grove Drive sellers and a non-asset for buyers until it is approved and funded.

Two elementary schools inside one small sub-area. Forest Grove Elementary (8525 Forest Grove Dr) and Stoney Creek Community Elementary (2740 Beaverbrook Cres) both sit inside this pocket, and Forest Grove Park (8505 Forest Grove Dr) holds the outdoor tennis and basketball courts — the pocket's amenity core is school-and-park, not retail; there is no enclosed mall or shopping centre inside the sub-area, and Lougheed Town Centre (south) is the shopping destination.

The attached side supplied the sub-area's only sale. In September 2026 Forest Hills' single sale came from the attached stock (1 of 6 listed, 17%) while its single detached listing did not sell — the reverse of the pattern in Burnaby's detached pockets.

One complex's neighbour is a tank farm. Wembley Estates sits roughly 50 metres from the entrance to the Burnaby Terminal on the strata council's own filing — a fact no listing copy mentions, and the reason that complex carries a federal hearing record at all.
The library branch is a temporary location. The Cameron Branch serving this quadrant of Burnaby Public Library is at 9855 Austin Ave, listed as a temporary location in the research pass.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Forest Hills
Streets, schools and getting around Forest Hills

items.t: Where the townhouse stock concentrates: entirely in the Forest Grove / Stoney Creek pocket — 1980s strata townhome complexes on Forest Grove Drive and Ash Grove Crescent. There is no verified apartment-condo building inside the sub-area at all: the attached stock is these townhomes, plus three housing co-operatives that are excluded as tenure traps.

SnapStats publishes medians at community level only, not for the Forest Hills sub-area: Burnaby-wide for September 2026, Condos & Townhomes median sale price $686,000; $763/sqft; sale-to-list 98%; 36 days on market — a COMBINED condos-and-townhomes figure for all of Burnaby, never a Forest Hills townhome-only figure. Sub-area median prices by property type: UNVERIFIED.

Edges, roads and transit: Simon Fraser University and Simon Fraser Hills to the east and up the mountain, Oakdale and Sullivan Heights to the south-east, the Lochdale / Parkcrest side to the west, Lougheed Town Centre to the south. Gaglardi Way is the road up Burnaby Mountain to SFU and Lougheed Highway runs along the south side. No SkyTrain station sits inside Forest Hills; Production Way–University Station (Millennium Line, with the Expo Line Lougheed branch) is south-west and is the transfer point for SFU bus service.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Forest Hills

items.t: Fee-simple houses (the pocket's other product): The co-operatives in are a third thing again: membership housing with a share purchase, under neither frame.

City zoning — current bylaw: Burnaby consolidated its single- and two-family districts into one R1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) District in June 2024: R1 lots may hold 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 units on larger lots, and 6 units on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop; SSMUH lots require a minimum lot width of 10 m and minimum lot area of 281 m²; permitted forms include single-family homes, duplexes, multiplexes, rowhouses and secondary suites, and lots with two or more primary units may be stratified.

Burnaby taxes and utilities: City of Burnaby property taxes for 2026 were due Friday, July 3, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to outstanding current taxes (and to an unclaimed home owner grant) after the July due date, with a further 5% penalty after the September due date; Council approved a 2.9% property tax increase in the 2026–2030 Financial Plan.

Hillside Place (8400 Forest Grove Dr), Whattlekainum (8740 Forest Grove Dr) and Pine Ridge (8763 Ash Grove Cres) are all housing co-operatives in BC Housing's Zone 5 directory — they surface in address searches as large multi-unit sites, but none of them can be bought as strata.

The library branch serving the pocket is a temporary location. The Cameron Branch of Burnaby Public Library, in the Lougheed Town Centre area at 9855 Austin Ave, is listed as a temporary location in the research pass — check the branch's current address before promising library proximity in a listing.
Match strata documents by address and plan (NW2129 is Henley Estate's), not by name fragments.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Forest Hills
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Established-slope house lots: A fee-simple lot carries NO strata, NO Form B and NO strata fees.

Lot character: typical lot sizes are UNVERIFIED at sub-area level — no official source read states them. The documented figures are the R1 SSMUH rules themselves: a minimum lot width of 10 m and minimum lot area of 281 m² for SSMUH lots, 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 units on larger lots, and 6 units on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop. These are zoning thresholds, not a claim about any existing lot's size.

Serviced position, as the City states it: Burnaby's 2026 residential utility notice covers annual water, annual sewer use, a cross-connection device charge where applicable and a residential garbage toter fee; the detached single-family dwelling water charge is $652.33, rates carry a 5% discount if paid by the due date, and for single-family homes sewer is billed as a sewer parcel tax on the property tax notice. Confirm servicing for the specific parcel with the City.

Slope and creek character: the homes sit on sloped lots below the Burnaby Mountain Conservation Area and Stoney Creek runs through the area toward Burnaby Lake — parcel-level setbacks, slope conditions and hazard status are property-specific checks: UNVERIFIED for individual lots.

ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR parcel in Forest Hills is confirmed in the research; no ALR percentage split is stated. ALR status is a property-specific check in the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder.

Market context, labelled correctly: Burnaby IS a SnapStats-covered community; SnapStats has NO land category. September 2026 context only, never land figures: Forest Hills sub-area detached inventory 1 / solds 0 and "Condos & Townhomes" combined 6 / 1 (17%); Burnaby community detached median $1,825,000 and "Condos & Townhomes" combined median $686,000. Sub-area medians are UNVERIFIED (community level only).

blocks.text: Bare-land strata

items.t: No bare-land strata plan in Forest Hills was verified: The pocket's strata complexes (below) are conventional freehold-strata townhouse plans on shared strata ground, NOT bare-land strata plans, and are never re-described as such.

blocks.text: Built strata and co-op ground

items.t: The four verified townhome complexes

Three housing co-operatives sit on Forest Grove / Ash Grove ground: — Hillside Place Housing Co-operative (8400 Forest Grove Dr), Pine Ridge Co-operative (8763 Ash Grove Cres) and Whattlekainum Co-operative Housing Association (8740 Forest Grove Dr), all listed in BC Housing's Zone 5 affordable-housing directory.
Avonlea — 2600 Beaverbrook Crescent (strata plan LMS101, built 1991, freehold strata per the listing record): counted 0 here: It is a built townhouse complex in any case, not a lot offering.

UniverCity / SFU ground — out of area, never imported: all UniverCity product belongs to the Simon Fraser Univer. sub-area; its tenure there is 99-year prepaid leasehold strata on SFU Community Trust ground leases, never freehold — stated here only so a cross-shopping buyer does not mistake mountain-top leasehold ground for Forest Hills fee-simple ground.

blocks.text: Proposals

items.t: Burnaby Mountain Gondola (TransLink proposal): TransLink is developing the business case for a proposed 3S gondola from Production Way–University Station straight to SFU's Burnaby campus — a route whose cabins would pass above the Forest Grove neighbourhood. Burnaby City Council endorsed the project and route in 2022 and over 85% of 2020 engagement participants supported the straight route, but the project is not yet approved or funded — it must be included in a future investment plan and approved by the TransLink Board and the Mayors' Council. It is a transit proposal over the pocket's lots, not a development site and not for-sale inventory; TransLink states the gondola would serve the 25,000 daily trips made by SFU students, staff, faculty, visitors and UniverCity residents.
: A market residential presale inside Forest Hills verified on a developer source: UNVERIFIED — none is counted.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Forest Hills

items.t: Main roads: Forest Grove Drive and Beaverbrook Crescent run through the pocket; Gaglardi Way is the road up Burnaby Mountain to SFU, and Lougheed Highway runs along the south side toward Lougheed Town Centre and Highway 1.
Nearby areas: SFU and Simon Fraser Hills to the east and up the mountain, Oakdale and Sullivan Heights to the south-east, the Lochdale / Parkcrest side to the west, Lougheed Town Centre to the south.

Transit: Production Way–University Station (Millennium Line, with the Expo Line Lougheed branch) is south-west of the sub-area and is the SkyTrain transfer point for SFU bus service up Burnaby Mountain; no SkyTrain station sits inside Forest Hills. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Civic anchors: Forest Grove Park, 8505 Forest Grove Dr (outdoor tennis and basketball courts at the same address); the Burnaby Mountain Conservation Area trail network is in and above the sub-area, and Stoney Creek runs through the area toward Burnaby Lake. The city's hospital is Burnaby Hospital, 3935 Kincaid St, south-west of Forest Hills.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Forest Hills

items.t: Creek and slope diligence: Stoney Creek runs through the area toward Burnaby Lake — confirm streamside setbacks and any slope conditions for the specific parcel before pricing redevelopment value on Beaverbrook- and ravine-edge lots.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Forest Hills ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR. Check the parcel on ALC mapping before applying any of this.

blocks.text: Good to know about Forest Hills

items.t: The gondola is endorsed, popular — and unfunded (status as documented Nov 1, 2026): Burnaby Council endorsed the project and route in 2022, over 85% of 2020 engagement participants supported the straight route, and the project still must be included in a future TransLink investment plan and approved by the TransLink Board and the Mayors' Council. It is the single biggest open land-value question over Forest Grove lots, in both directions.

One townhome complex sits about 50 metres from a pipeline terminal entrance: Wembley Estates' own strata council filing in the Trans Mountain Expansion Project hearing record places the 28-unit complex roughly 50 metres from the entrance to the Burnaby Terminal — a fact in the complex's own record that a lot-or-unit buyer on Underhill Avenue should know before, not after, writing.

The creek is in the sub-area's second school name: Stoney Creek Community Elementary (2740 Beaverbrook Cres) is an SD41 community school as named by the district, and Stoney Creek itself runs through the pocket toward Burnaby Lake — the same watercourse that drives the setback checks on ravine-edge lots.

faq.q: Where is Forest Hills in Burnaby?
faq.a: On the lower south-west slopes of Burnaby Mountain, around Forest Grove Drive and Beaverbrook Crescent, below Simon Fraser University and above Lougheed Highway. "Forest Hills" is the GVR MLS® sub-area name; locally the pocket is called Forest Grove (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools are located in Forest Hills?
faq.a: Forest Grove Elementary (K–7), 8525 Forest Grove Dr, and Stoney Creek Community Elementary (K–7), 2740 Beaverbrook Cres, with Burnaby Mountain Secondary (8–12), 8800 Eastlake Dr, the nearest secondary; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: Will the Burnaby Mountain Gondola affect Forest Grove homes?
faq.a: It is proposed, not built: TransLink's endorsed Route 1 runs straight from Production Way–University Station to SFU with cabins passing above the Forest Grove neighbourhood; Burnaby Council endorsed it in 2022, but it is not yet approved or funded.

faq.q: What sold in Forest Hills in September 2026?
faq.a: One condos & townhomes sale from 6 listings (17% sales ratio); the sub-area's single detached listing did not sell, so the detached sales ratio is not applicable. Burnaby-wide, the median detached sale price was $1,825,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $686,000 that month (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Is there a park in the sub-area?
faq.a: Yes — Forest Grove Park, 8505 Forest Grove Dr, with outdoor tennis and basketball courts, and the Burnaby Mountain Conservation Area trails in and above the pocket.

faq.q: Are there apartment condos in Forest Hills, or only townhomes?
faq.a: Only townhome complexes were verified: Rossmoor (1981), Henley Estate (1984), Wembley Estates (1984) and Ashbrook Place (1986). No apartment-condo building inside the sub-area was verified, and SnapStats publishes the attached figures combined as "Condos & Townhomes," so the split is UNCONFIRMED.

faq.q: Is the complex at 8400 Forest Grove Drive a condo I can buy?
faq.a: No — 8400 Forest Grove Drive is Hillside Place Housing Co-operative in BC Housing's directory: membership housing, not a strata purchase. The same applies at Pine Ridge Co-operative (8763 Ash Grove Crescent) and Whattlekainum Co-operative (8740 Forest Grove Drive).

faq.q: Can I rent out a Forest Hills townhome long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, whatever older bylaw text says. Short-term rentals are different: a strata bylaw can still restrict them, and the registered bylaws on the Form B govern that question.

faq.q: What envelope work has been done on the 1980s stock?
faq.a: One published example: Rossmoor is described in a current listing as a rainscreened complex with HardiePlank siding, windows, doors, fencing, roadway and lighting renewed. For the other complexes, completed envelope work: UNCONFIRMED — the depreciation report (now required every five years for stratas with five or more lots) is the document that answers it.
Any price opinion needs a longer window and comparables from Simon Fraser Hills, Sullivan Heights and the wider Lougheed side.

faq.q: What townhouses can I actually buy in Forest Hills?
faq.a: Four strata complexes, all 1980s: Rossmoor (9101/9151 Forest Grove Drive, built 1981), Henley Estate (8210/8218 Forest Grove Drive, NW2129, built 1984), Wembley Estates (8187 Forest Grove Drive, 28 units, built 1984) and Ashbrook Place (9000 Ash Grove Crescent, built 1986). No apartment condos, no fee-simple townhouse complex, and no presale were verified in the sub-area.

faq.q: Is the complex at 8400 Forest Grove Drive a townhouse I can buy?
faq.a: No — 8400 Forest Grove Drive is Hillside Place Housing Co-operative in BC Housing's directory: membership housing with a share purchase, not a strata purchase. The same applies at Whattlekainum Co-operative (8740 Forest Grove Drive) and Pine Ridge Co-operative (8763 Ash Grove Crescent).

faq.q: Can I rent out a Forest Hills townhouse long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since Nov 24, 2022 anywhere in BC, whatever older bylaw text says. Short-term rentals are different: a strata bylaw can still restrict them, and the registered bylaws on the Form B govern that question.
